name: KDP K-Cup Plant - Essex Junction VT

fieldNotes.location: Roster address '63 South Park Dr' and pin (44.503824,-73.180386) were wrong - ~3.6 km off, landing in Essex Junction commercial sprawl. Correct facility is the Keurig Green Mountain / KDP coffee roasting and K-Cup complex at 30 Gauthier Dr / 5 New England Dr, Essex Junction VT 05452 (44.513632,-73.136469). Confirmed via Vermont Business Magazine, GMCR 2011 expansion press release (350,000 sq ft addition connecting 30 Gauthier Dr and 5 New England Dr), and warehouserating.com listing. Williston VT operations consolidated here in 2024.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Open driveways from the internal industrial-park road into the W truck court and N dock area. No barrier arm, sliding gate, or checkpoint pinch-point visible in z19-z20 satellite or 2011 Street View. No perimeter fence on the publicly visible sides.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No booth-footprint structure at any of the truck-court entrances in satellite or Street View.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Connected multi-building campus - main K-Cup/roasting plant plus additional connected/adjacent buildings, with separate trailer drop yards to the N/NE and S.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Two dedicated trailer drop yards: a row-parked lot on the N/NE side (~25-30 trailers) and another on the S side (~15-20 trailers). Banded 25-50.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock banks on the W building face (~10-12 trailers backed in) and the N building face (additional dock bank). Total estimated 25-50, medium confidence.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock activity split across at least two distinct building faces (W and N) suggesting separate shipping/receiving clusters.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Suburban industrial park within the greater Burlington VT metro fabric (Essex Junction); dense surrounding industrial/commercial development - Urban.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: 4 is an estimate for the connected/adjacent building cluster; the complex is multi-building and hard to count distinct structures from overhead.
fieldNotes.imageryNote: Street View is 2011-vintage; satellite is recent. Gate/guard-shack determination relies primarily on recent satellite plus older SV - both show open access.
